name: Luma Ray3.2 (Dream Machine API)

access.regionNotes: First-party API at api.lumalabs.ai. Pay-per-video with no subscription or minimum.

pricing.unit: per second or per 5 s clip
pricing.publicRate: 720p $0.06/s ($0.30 per 5 s clip); 1080p $0.24/s ($1.20 per 5 s clip). HDR is 2x, HDR+EXR is 3x.
pricing.note: Read 2026-09-05 via third-party comparison tables. The 720p to 1080p jump is roughly 4x, not linear.

notes: No local run exists in this repository.
Supports keyframe-guided generation and looping, which maps onto the same storyboard use case covered by the Grok failure records here.
No native audio, so dialogue workflows need a separate audio stage.
